show.description: When Riya’s world collapses under the weight of her father Ranjeet’s betrayal and her family’s ruin, she rises with unshakable strength to protect her ailing grandparents and reclaim their lost dignity. Torn between love, sacrifice, and vengeance, Riya’s journey from a helpless granddaughter to a fierce protector proves that true safety lies not in others but in the arms of one’s own courage. Watch Now!
